Anupinder Singh Grewal, J. (Oral)

The petitioners are seeking quashing of FIR No.75 dated 18.03.2019, under Sections 420, 406, 506,
120-B IPC, registered at Police Station Dera Bassi, District SAS Nagar on the basis of compromise dated 11.04.2023 (Annexure P-2), which has been arrived at between the parties.
2.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the FIR is outcome of a monetary dispute between the petitioners and respondent No.2 which has now been resolved and the matter has been compromised.

He has referred to a copy of the compromise at Annexure P-3.
3.
Learned counsel has put in appearance on behalf of respondent No.2 and submits that the matter has indeed been compromised.

The report of the Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Dera Bassi, dated 10.05.2023 has been received, wherein it is stated that in pursuance to the order of this Court, the statements of the parties were recorded which indicates that compromise which has been effected is genuine,
voluntary and without undue influence.
5.
Heard.
The FIR is outcome of a monetary dispute between the petitioners and respondent No.2 which has now been resolved and the matter has been compromised.
In view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of Narinder Singh vs. State of Punjab 2014 (6) SCC 466, no useful purpose will be served by continuing the criminal proceedings.
